# Suggested learning sequence

A sequence for an experienced senior executive in Ireland who wants to build credibility across AI transformation, strategy and advisory work, board-level governance, and practical implementation. It starts with low-cost literacy and a recognised governance credential, then moves to strategy, then hands-on building. Core steps cover all four objectives. Optional steps add depth or an alternative. Re-check dates and prices on the official page before enrolling.

Hours and costs come from the database dated 2026-10-22; EUR conversions use the European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-10-21. Totals add only published figures. Anything not published or not verified is listed separately, so the totals are a floor, not a quote.

## Stage 1: Shared vocabulary and executive framing

Build fluent, current understanding of generative AI and agents that you can use with boards and clients. About two to four weeks part-time.

Gain a recognised AI governance credential that covers the EU AI Act and risk management. This is the strongest differentiator for board and advisory work in Ireland and the EU.

## Notes

- Order is a suggestion. Stages 2 and 4 can run in parallel if you prefer variety.
- If you want an assessed university qualification instead of short courses, compare ucd-smurfit-diploma-ai-business-analytics (in person, NFQ Level 9) and atu-pgdip-big-data-analytics-ai (Springboard+ funded where eligible) in the catalogue.
- Free audit options rarely include graded work or a certificate. Budget for a subscription if you want the credential.
- No credential here guarantees employment or advancement. Pick steps that produce evidence you can show, such as a governance framework, business case or working prototype.
